About that time, King Herod reached out to harm some who belonged to the church.

那時，希律王下手苦害教會中幾個人，
He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.

用刀殺了約翰的哥哥雅各。
And seeing that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.

他見猶太人喜歡這事，又去捉拿彼得。那時正是除酵的日子。

希律拿了彼得，收在監裡，交付四班兵丁看守，每班四個人，意思要在逾越節後把他提出來，當著百姓辦他。
So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to God for him.
So Peter was kept in prison: but the church made strong prayer to God for him.
於是彼得被囚在監裡；教會卻為他切切地禱告神。
On the night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, with sentries standing guard at the entrance to the prison.

希律將要提他出來的前一夜，彼得被兩條鐵鍊鎖著，睡在兩個兵丁當中；看守的人也在門外看守。
Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He tapped Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Get up quickly.” And the chains fell off his wrists.

And a great light was seen shining in the room, and an angel of the Lord came to Peter and, touching him on his side so that he came out of his sleep, said, Get up quickly. And his chains came off his hands.
忽然，有主的一個使者站在旁邊，屋裡有光照耀，天使拍彼得的肋旁，拍醒了他，說：「快快起來！」那鐵鍊就從他手上脫落下來。
“Get dressed and put on your sandals,” said the angel. Peter did so, and the angel told him, “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me.”
Then the angel said, Put on your shoes and get ready to go. And he did so. And he said, Put your coat round you and come with me.
天使對他說：「束上帶子，穿上鞋。」他就那樣做。天使又說：「披上外衣，跟著我來。」
So Peter followed him out, but he was unaware that what the angel was doing was real. He thought he was only seeing a vision.

彼得就出來跟著他，不知道天使所做是真的，只當見了異象。

They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city, which opened for them by itself. When they had gone outside and walked the length of one block, the angel suddenly left him.
And when they had gone past the first and second watchmen they came to the iron door into the town, which came open by itself: and they went out and down one street; and then the angel went away.
過了第一層第二層監牢，就來到臨街的鐵門，那門自己開了。他們出來，走過一條街，天使便離開他去了。
Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod’s grasp and from everything the Jewish people were anticipating.”

彼得醒悟過來，說：「我現在真知道主差遣他的使者，救我脫離希律的手和猶太百姓一切所盼望的。」
And when he had realized this, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered together and were praying.

想了一想，就往那稱呼馬可的約翰、他母親馬利亞家去，在那裡有好些人聚集禱告。
He knocked at the outer gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.

彼得敲外門，有一個使女，名叫羅大，出來探聽，
When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed that she forgot to open the gate, but ran inside and announced, “Peter is standing at the gate!”
And hearing the voice of Peter, in her joy she went running, without opening the door, to say that Peter was outside.
聽得是彼得的聲音，就歡喜的顧不得開門，跑進去告訴眾人說：「彼得站在門外。」
“You are out of your mind,” they told her. But when she kept insisting it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”
And they said to her, You are off your head. But still she said, with decision, that it was so. And they said, It is his angel.
他們說：「你是瘋了！」使女極力地說：「真是他！」他們說：「必是他的天使！」
But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
But Peter went on giving blows on the door: and when it was open and they saw him, they were full of wonder.
彼得不住地敲門。他們開了門，看見他，就甚驚奇。
Peter motioned with his hand for silence, and he described how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. “Send word to James and to the brothers,” he said, and he left for another place.

But he made a sign to them with his hand to be quiet, and gave them an account of how the Lord had taken him out of prison. And he said, Give the news to James and the brothers. And then he went away.
彼得擺手，不要他們作聲，就告訴他們主怎樣領他出監；又說：「你們把這事告訴雅各和眾弟兄。」於是出去，往別處去了。
At daybreak there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
Now when it was day, the armed men were greatly troubled about what had become of Peter.
到了天亮，兵丁擾亂得很，不知道彼得往哪裡去了。
After Herod had searched for him unsuccessfully, he examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent some time there.
And Herod, when he sent for him, and he was not there, after questioning the watchmen, gave orders that they were to be put to death. Then he went down from Judaea to Caesarea for a time.
希律找他，找不著，就審問看守的人，吩咐把他們拉去殺了。後來希律離開猶太，下凱撒利亞去，住在那裡。

Now Herod was in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they convened before him. Having secured the support of Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their region depended on the king’s country for food.

Now he was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon: and they came to him, all together, and having made friends with Blastus, the controller of the king's house, they made a request for peace, because their country was dependent on the king's country for its food.
希律惱怒泰爾、西頓的人。他們那一帶地方是從王的地土得糧，因此就託了王的內侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心來求和。
On the appointed day, Herod donned his royal robes, sat on his throne, and addressed the people.
And on the day which had been fixed, Herod, dressed in his robes and seated in his place, made a public statement to them.
希律在所定的日子，穿上朝服，坐在位上，對他們講論一番。
And they began to shout, “This is the voice of a god, not a man!”
And the people, with loud cries, said, It is the voice of a god, not of a man.
百姓喊著說：「這是神的聲音，不是人的聲音。」
Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.

希律不歸榮耀給神，所以主的使者立刻罰他，他被蟲所咬，氣就絕了。
